name: exp07-standard
content:
*   The architecture uses separate SQLite files for host and agent to eliminate lock contention, ensuring each side has exclusive write access to its own database.
*   It employs DELETE journal mode and file-based heartbeats to guarantee cross-mount visibility and avoid database write path overhead, despite slightly slower write performance.
*   Even-odd sequence numbering provides natural message ordering and source identification without coordination, trading minor complexity for reliability in infrequent, small-agent workloads.
